overviewParagraphs: Garden City Golf Club is Phnom Penh's most professionally structured golf operation — managed by IMG, one of global golf's most respected event and facility management organisations, the course operates to management standards and conditioning protocols consistent with internationally recognised professional events rather than the casual resort approaches typical of the regional market.

The course design itself emphasises openness and variety: generous fairway widths accommodate players of all abilities off the tee, while the undulating greens — which slope and contour in ways that create genuine three-putt risk for casual readers — provide the precision challenge that rewards thorough course reconnaissance and disciplined putting stroke execution. The overall experience is one of professional-grade golf delivered with the hospitality warmth that Cambodia does so naturally well.

For discerning golfers visiting Phnom Penh, Garden City Golf Club provides an excellent standalone round or an ideal companion to the Chhun On facility — the different design characters of the two courses create a satisfying Phnom Penh two-round combination. AGS regularly pairs these venues for clients spending two or more days in the capital.

curatorBriefHtml: Garden City Golf Club (opened 2013 by Thai architect Weerayudth Phetbuasak and managed by IMG, 30–35 minutes northeast of central Phnom Penh) is one of Cambodia’s most respected and consistently conditioned 18-hole championship layouts. Playing 6,215 yards from the Blue Tees (7,361 yards Championship, Par 72), Garden City features open, wind-influenced corridors, sharp mounding, strategic water lakes, and fast, undulating greens that reward precise wedge play.

Having played Garden City personally, IMG’s management shows in every detail — clean fairways, attentive caddies, crisp greens, and a spacious modern clubhouse (with an adjacent hotel for ultra-convenient stays). It is a rewarding, fair championship exam that complements Vattanac’s dramatic temple spectacle.
AGS pairs Garden City cleanly with Vattanac Golf Resort and Chhun On on Phnom Penh and dual-city Cambodia itineraries.

scorecard.verdict: Set on the northern outskirts of Phnom Penh, Garden City features broad fairways guarded by large water reservoirs and slick undulating greens. Impeccably conditioned year-round.

faqs.q: What kind of challenge does Garden City Golf Club offer in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Managed by IMG, Garden City plays across open, undulating terrain (6,215 yards Blue Tees / 7,361 yards Tips, Par 72) where breezy conditions, strategic lakes, and contoured fast greens test approach-shot control.

faqs.q: How far is Garden City Golf Club from downtown Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Approximately 30 to 40 minutes northeast of central Phnom Penh (Rosewood / Raffles) via private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Is Garden City Golf Club open to international visitors?
faqs.a: Yes — Garden City welcomes international touring golfers throughout the week with pre-booked tee times, caddies, and carts arranged through AGS.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Garden City?
faqs.a: November through March is Cambodia’s dry high season, though IMG’s drainage keeps Garden City playable year-round with morning tee times.
